larkSetup.prompt: Help me set up Lark Assistant as a complete beginner. Give me only one clear step at a time and avoid unnecessary technical detail. Use the Lark CLI managed by CSBU WorkMate and first verify it with lark-cli config --help. If unavailable, guide me to the in-app CLI update or restore controls instead of installing another copy. Start by explaining how to create a custom Lark app for my own use, and remind me to enter the App Secret only in the Lark CLI configuration flow and never send it in chat. Run lark-cli config init --new, then request all user permissions once with lark-cli auth login --domain all --no-wait --json. When the authorization URL is generated, show both the original URL and a QR code, then stop and wait for me to reply “Done”. After that, complete the device-code flow yourself and verify the connection with lark-cli auth status --json --verify. When successful, give me three ready-to-use example requests. Do not install the upstream full skill bundle. Still ask for my confirmation before sending, deleting, approving, changing permissions, or other high-risk actions.
